import json, os, socket, sqlite3, subprocess, tempfile, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = os.getcwd()
SERVER = str(Path(ROOT) / \"server\")
PYTHON = r\"<BUNDLED_PYTHON>\"
procs = []

def free_port():
    s = socket.socket()
    s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    s.close()
    return port

def start(db):
    port = free_port()
    p = subprocess.Popen([SERVER, \"--db\", str(db), \"--listen\", f\"127.0.0.1:{port}\"],
                         cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    procs.append(p)
    base = f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\"
    deadline = time.time() + 20
    while time.time() < deadline:
        if p.poll() is not None:
            raise AssertionError(\"server exited: \" + p.stderr.read().decode(errors=\"replace\"))
        try:
            status, payload = call(base, \"GET\", \"/health\")
            if status == 200 and payload == {\"ok\": True}:
                return p, base
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(0.05)
    raise AssertionError(\"server did not become healthy\")

def call(base, method, path, body=None, tenant=None, key=None, raw=None, timeout=30):
    headers = {}
    if tenant is not None: headers[\"X-Tenant\"] = tenant
    if key is not None: headers[\"Idempotency-Key\"] = key
    if body is not None:
        raw = json.dumps(body, separators=(\",\", \":\")).encode()
        headers[\"Content-Type\"] = \"application/json\"
    data = raw
    req = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            status, payload = resp.status, resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, e.read()
    try:
        value = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
    except Exception:
        value = payload.decode(errors=\"replace\")
    return status, value

def expect(base, method, path, code, **kwargs):
    status, value = call(base, method, path, **kwargs)
    assert status == code, (method, path, status, value, code)
    return value

def stop(p, expected=0):
    if p.poll() is None:
        p.terminate()
    rc = p.wait(timeout=20)
    err = p.stderr.read().decode(errors=\"replace\")
    assert rc == expected, (\"server exit\", rc, err)

def stop_all():
    for p in reversed(procs):
        if p.poll() is None:
            p.terminate()
        try: p.wait(timeout=20)
        except Exception: p.kill()

def account(base, name, opening, key, tenant=\"t\"):
    return expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 201, tenant=tenant, key=key,
                  body={\"name\": name, \"opening\": opening})[\"account\"]

try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"auditledger-check-\") as td:
        db = Path(td) / \"main.sqlite\"
        p1, base = start(db)

        assert call(base, \"GET\", \"/health\")[0] == 200
        expect(base, \"GET\", \"/accounts/A\", 400)
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 400, tenant=\"t\", body={\"name\":\"x\",\"opening\":1})
        a0 = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"acctA\",
                    raw=b'{\"opening\":100,\"name\":\"A\"}')
        replay = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"acctA\",
                        raw=b'{ \"name\" : \"A\", \"opening\" : 100 }')
        assert replay == a0
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 409, tenant=\"t\", key=\"acctA\",
               body={\"name\":\"A\",\"opening\":101})
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/holds\", 409, tenant=\"t\", key=\"acctA\", body={})

        account(base, \"B\", 20, \"acctB\")
        account(base, \"C\", 0, \"acctC\")
        tr1 = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"tr1\",
                     raw=b'{\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":7,\"from_version\":1,\"from\":\"A\",\"to_version\":1}')[\"transfer\"]
        tr1_result = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"tr1\",
                            body={\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":7,\"from_version\":1,\"to_version\":1})
        assert tr1_result[\"transfer\"] == tr1
        assert tr1_result[\"accounts\"][0][\"version\"] == 2
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", 409, tenant=\"t\", key=\"tr1\",
               body={\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":8,\"from_version\":1,\"to_version\":1})
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 409, tenant=\"t\", key=\"tr1\", body={\"name\":\"Z\",\"opening\":1})

        before_fail = expect(base, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
        failed_batch = {\"transfers\":[
            {\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"C\",\"amount\":5},
            {\"from\":\"C\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":999}]}
        err = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/batches\", 409, tenant=\"t\", key=\"batch-retry\", body=failed_batch)
        assert err[\"error\"][\"code\"] == \"insufficient\"
        after_fail = expect(base, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
        assert after_fail == before_fail, (before_fail, after_fail)
        good_batch = {\"transfers\":[
            {\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"C\",\"amount\":5},
            {\"from\":\"C\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":3}]}
        batch_result = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/batches\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"batch-retry\", body=good_batch)
        assert [x[\"name\"] for x in batch_result[\"accounts\"]] == [\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"]
        assert [x[\"version\"] for x in batch_result[\"accounts\"]] == [3,3,3]
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/batches\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"batch-retry\",
               raw=b'{ \"transfers\" : [ {\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"C\",\"amount\":5}, {\"from\":\"C\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":3} ] }')

        h1 = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/holds\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"hold1\",
                    body={\"account\":\"A\",\"amount\":10})[\"hold\"]
        held_snap = expect(base, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"snapshot\"]
        held_summary = expect(base, \"GET\", f\"/summary?snapshot={held_snap}\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
        assert held_summary[\"accounts\"][0][\"balance\"] == 88
        assert held_summary[\"accounts\"][0][\"reserved\"] == 10
        h2 = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/holds\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"hold2\",
                    body={\"account\":\"A\",\"amount\":4})[\"hold\"]
        released = expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/holds/{h2['id']}/release\", 200,
                          tenant=\"t\", key=\"release2\", body={})
        assert released[\"hold\"][\"state\"] == \"released\"
        captured = expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/holds/{h1['id']}/capture\", 200,
                          tenant=\"t\", key=\"capture1\", body={\"to\":\"B\"})
        assert captured[\"hold\"][\"state\"] == \"captured\"
        cap_replay = expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/holds/{h1['id']}/capture\", 200,
                            tenant=\"t\", key=\"capture1\", body={\"to\":\"B\"})
        assert cap_replay == captured
        expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/holds/{h1['id']}/capture\", 409, tenant=\"t\",
               key=\"capture-terminal\", body={\"to\":\"B\"})
        expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/holds/{h1['id']}/release\", 409, tenant=\"t\",
               key=\"release-terminal\", body={})
        cap_id = captured[\"transfer\"][\"id\"]
        reversed_result = expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/transfers/{cap_id}/reverse\", 200,
                                 tenant=\"t\", key=\"reverse1\",
                                 body={\"from_version\":7,\"to_version\":4})
        assert reversed_result[\"transfer\"][\"reversed\"] is True
        assert reversed_result[\"reversal\"][\"from\"] == \"B\"
        assert reversed_result[\"accounts\"][0][\"name\"] == \"A\"
        assert [x[\"balance\"] for x in reversed_result[\"accounts\"]] == [88,30]
        expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/transfers/{cap_id}/reverse\", 409, tenant=\"t\",
               key=\"reverse-again\", body={})
        expect(base, \"POST\", f\"/transfers/{reversed_result['reversal']['id']}/reverse\", 409,
               tenant=\"t\", key=\"reverse-reversal\", body={})

        historical = expect(base, \"GET\", f\"/summary?snapshot={held_snap}\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
        assert historical == held_summary
        first = expect(base, \"GET\", f\"/entries?after=0&limit=3&snapshot={held_snap}\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
        collected = list(first[\"entries\"])
        assert first[\"has_more\"] and first[\"next_after\"] == collected[-1][\"seq\"]
        after = first[\"next_after\"]
        while first[\"has_more\"]:
            first = expect(base, \"GET\",
                           f\"/entries?after={after}&limit=3&snapshot={held_snap}\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
            collected.extend(first[\"entries\"])
            after = first[\"next_after\"]
        assert len(collected) == held_summary[\"entry_count\"]
        assert [e[\"seq\"] for e in collected] == sorted(e[\"seq\"] for e in collected)
        current = expect(base, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"t\")
        assert [(a[\"name\"],a[\"balance\"],a[\"reserved\"]) for a in current[\"accounts\"]] == [
            (\"A\",88,0),(\"B\",30,0),(\"C\",2,0)]
        assert current[\"totals\"] == {\"balance\":120,\"reserved\":0,\"available\":120}
        assert current[\"entry_count\"] == 16
        assert expect(base, \"GET\", \"/accounts/A\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"account\"][\"version\"] == 8
        assert expect(base, \"GET\", \"/accounts/A\", 404, tenant=\"other\")[\"error\"][\"code\"] == \"not_found\"
        expect(base, \"GET\", \"/summary?unknown=1\", 400, tenant=\"t\")
        expect(base, \"GET\", \"/entries?after=-1\", 400, tenant=\"t\")
        expect(base, \"GET\", \"/entries?limit=0\", 400, tenant=\"t\")
        expect(base, \"GET\", \"/entries?after=1&after=2\", 400, tenant=\"t\")
        expect(base, \"GET\", f\"/summary?snapshot={current['snapshot']+1}\", 400, tenant=\"t\")
        expect(base, \"GET\", \"/accounts/bad"'!", 400, tenant="t")
        expect(base, "GET", "/transfers/x/y", 404, tenant="t")

        invalid_bodies = [
            (b'"'{\"name\":\"Z\",\"opening\":1,\"extra\":2}', \"inv-unknown\"),
            (b'{\"name\":\"Z\",\"opening\":1} {}', \"inv-trailing\"),
            (b'{\"name\":\"Z\",\"opening\":1.0}', \"inv-float\"),
            (b'{\"name\":\"bad"'!","opening":1}'"', \"inv-name\"),
            (b'[]', \"inv-array\"),
            (b'', \"inv-empty\"),
        ]
        for raw_body, key in invalid_bodies:
            resp = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 400, tenant=\"t\", key=key, raw=raw_body)
            assert resp[\"error\"][\"code\"] == \"invalid\"
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", 400, tenant=\"t\", key=\"inv-version\",
               raw=b'{\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":1,\"from_version\":null}')
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 400, tenant=\"t\", body={\"name\":\"X\",\"opening\":1})
        expect(base, \"POST\", \"/missing\", 404, tenant=\"t\", key=\"unknown-path\", body={})

        account(base, \"D\", 1000, \"acctD\")
        account(base, \"E\", 1000, \"acctE\")
        concurrent_body = {\"from\":\"D\",\"to\":\"E\",\"amount\":1}
        def same_retry(_):
            return call(base, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", body=concurrent_body, tenant=\"t\", key=\"same-retry\")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as pool:
            same = list(pool.map(same_retry, range(12)))
        assert all(status == 201 for status,_ in same), same
        assert all(value == same[0][1] for _,value in same), same
        assert expect(base, \"GET\", \"/accounts/D\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"account\"][\"version\"] == 2
        replay_tr1 = expect(base, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"tr1\",
                            body={\"from\":\"A\",\"to\":\"B\",\"amount\":7,\"from_version\":1,\"to_version\":1})
        assert replay_tr1 == tr1_result

        stop(p1)
        p2, base2 = start(db)
        assert expect(base2, \"GET\", \"/health\", 200) == {\"ok\":True}
        assert expect(base2, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"same-retry\",
                      body=concurrent_body)[1] if False else True
        status, persisted = call(base2, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", \"/transfers\", tenant=\"t\") if False else (None, None)
        # Replays and original versions survive graceful restart.
        status, persisted = call(base2, \"POST\", \"/transfers\", body=concurrent_body,
                                 tenant=\"t\", key=\"same-retry\")
        assert status == 201 and persisted == same[0][1]
        assert expect(base2, \"POST\", \"/accounts\", 201, tenant=\"t\", key=\"acctA\",
                      body={\"name\":\"A\",\"opening\":100}) == a0
        assert expect(base2, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"entry_count\"] == 20

        stop(p2)
        p3, base3 = start(db)
        p4, base4 = start(db)
        tasks = []
        for i in range(40):
            source, target = (\"D\",\"E\") if i % 2 == 0 else (\"E\",\"D\")
            tasks.append((source,target,f\"crossproc-{i}\"))
        def cross_write(item):
            source,target,key = item
            return call(base3 if int(key.rsplit(\"-\",1)[1])%2==0 else base4,
                        \"POST\", \"/transfers\",
                        body={\"from\":source,\"to\":target,\"amount\":1},
                        tenant=\"t\", key=key)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20) as pool:
            writes = list(pool.map(cross_write, tasks))
        assert all(status == 201 for status,_ in writes), writes
        d = expect(base3, \"GET\", \"/accounts/D\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"account\"]
        e = expect(base4, \"GET\", \"/accounts/E\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"account\"]
        assert d[\"version\"] == 42 and e[\"version\"] == 42, (d,e)
        assert d[\"balance\"] + e[\"balance\"] == 2000
        stop(p3); stop(p4)
        p5, base5 = start(db)
        assert expect(base5, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"t\")[\"totals\"][\"balance\"] == 2120

        # Create a real v1 database, then let two independent processes race migration.
        legacy_db = Path(td) / \"legacy.sqlite\"
        subprocess.run([PYTHON, str(Path(ROOT)/\"legacy/produce.py\"), str(legacy_db)],
                       check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        before = sqlite3.connect(legacy_db)
        assert before.execute(\"PRAGMA user_version\").fetchone()[0] == 1
        names = (\"legacy_accounts\",\"legacy_movements\",\"legacy_notes\")
        legacy_before = {}
        for name in names:
            sql = before.execute(\"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?\",(name,)).fetchone()[0]
            rows = before.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM {name} ORDER BY 1,2\").fetchall()
            legacy_before[name] = (sql, rows)
        before.close()
        lp1, legacy_base1 = start(legacy_db)
        lp2, legacy_base2 = start(legacy_db)
        assert expect(legacy_base1, \"GET\", \"/health\", 200) == {\"ok\":True}
        assert expect(legacy_base2, \"GET\", \"/health\", 200) == {\"ok\":True}
        check = sqlite3.connect(legacy_db)
        assert check.execute(\"PRAGMA user_version\").fetchone()[0] == 2
        for name in names:
            sql = check.execute(\"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?\",(name,)).fetchone()[0]
            rows = check.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM {name} ORDER BY 1,2\").fetchall()
            assert (sql,rows) == legacy_before[name], (name,legacy_before[name],(sql,rows))
        check.close()
        old_summary = expect(legacy_base1, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"old\")
        assert [(x[\"name\"],x[\"balance\"]) for x in old_summary[\"accounts\"]] == [(\"alpha\",83),(\"beta\",37)]
        assert old_summary[\"totals\"][\"balance\"] == 120 and old_summary[\"entry_count\"] == 8
        legacy_entries = expect(legacy_base1, \"GET\", \"/entries?limit=100\", 200, tenant=\"old\")[\"entries\"]
        imported = [e for e in legacy_entries if e.get(\"legacy_id\") is not None]
        assert len(imported) == 6
        assert {e[\"legacy_id\"] for e in imported} == {7,11}
        rev = expect(legacy_base1, \"POST\", \"/transfers/legacy-7/reverse\", 200,
                     tenant=\"old\", key=\"legacy-reverse\", body={})
        assert rev[\"transfer\"][\"legacy_id\"] == 7 and rev[\"transfer\"][\"reversed\"]
        stop(lp1); stop(lp2)
        lp3, legacy_base3 = start(legacy_db)
        assert expect(legacy_base3, \"GET\", \"/summary\", 200, tenant=\"old\")[\"entry_count\"] == 10
        assert expect(legacy_base3, \"POST\", \"/transfers/legacy-7/reverse\", 200,
                      tenant=\"old\", key=\"legacy-reverse\", body={}) == rev
        final_db = sqlite3.connect(legacy_db)
        assert final_db.execute(\"PRAGMA user_version\").fetchone()[0] == 2
        for name in names:
            rows = final_db.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM {name} ORDER BY 1,2\").fetchall()
            assert rows == legacy_before[name][1], name
        final_db.close()
        stop(lp3); stop(p5)
        print(\"PASS: strict HTTP validation; all write/read routes; atomic batch rollback; tenant isolation; idempotent replay and conflict; holds/capture/release/reversal; fixed snapshots and pagination; 12 identical retries; two-process shared writes; SIGTERM/restart persistence; genuine v1 migration raced by two processes with legacy schema/data/notes preserved.\")
finally:
    stop_all()
